cover_letter:
Dear Kon Mostakbalak Academy team,

I'm applying for the AI & Software Automation Instructor position. Your academy's emphasis on practical, career-oriented training in n8n and AI agents is exactly the kind of teaching I want to do: helping people build automations they can apply at work or offer as a freelance service.

In my current freelance and junior digital marketing work, I use AI tools and code daily. I integrate LLMs into WordPress and SEO workflows through MCP, write Python scripts to automate repetitive tasks, and connect services via APIs and webhooks. I've built websites with hand-coded JavaScript, structured data and authentication flows, and I've developed an Android app live on Google Play. This hands-on experience with APIs, JSON and AI integrations gives me a solid technical base for teaching n8n workflows, AI agents and reliable automation design.

I also have experience explaining technical concepts clearly. I've mentored clients through website builds, guided colleagues on SEO and CMS tools, and created documentation and training materials. My background includes front-end development in JavaScript and AngularJS, plus ongoing computer science coursework, so I'm comfortable going deep into custom logic when needed. While I haven't taught in a formal classroom setting, I've led workshops and Q&A sessions informally and enjoy the project-review process.

I'm eager to bring my automation and AI experience to your team and help students build portfolio-ready projects. Thank you for your consideration.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
